Its analytic-map results give the holomorphic constant-rank normal form under local rank constancy and the regular-level-set parametrization under derivative surjectivity at the marked point. Thus the common-neighbour conjecture fails at every base size and in arbitrarily large degrees; the explicit family is developed from binary deleted permutation modules and affine wreath-product actions. Escaping points and repelling periodic points are dense, uncountably many points have dense forward orbit, and for every nonempty open U and compact K omitting 0 all sufficiently large iterates of U cover K; the normal-sequence restriction and quantitative open-mapping lemmas are stated for arbitrary separated uniform codomains. The route is Chang–Liu–Liu's sharp correlation inequality for increasing Boolean functions f, g on the cube (the Fourier energy of g weighted by the largest influence of f on each index set is at most the harmonic mean of Cov(f,g) and Cov(f,g*)), with equality for AND, the corollary Cov(f,g) ≥ (minimum influence of f)/4 for self-dual g, and a weighted star theorem for nonnegative decreasing weights (arXiv:2609.19123). The witnesses are regular halved-flag graphs over every finite field with exact order, degree cap, and diameter, and the passage through all d uses a prime in (x, (1+ε)x) proved from the vendored PrimeNumberTheoremAnd modules (Cames van Batenburg–Korsky, arXiv:2608.03965; mixed human/AI provenance). The separation-width invariant realizes every value 0, 1, 2, …, ω, ω+1, and generation is equivalent to width at most ω; the paper's density-one and Turing-computability results are not formalized (Li–Han–Jiang–Gao, arXiv:2609.10525, over a Core library by Shuangping Li and Peng Zhang; AI-assisted under human direction). Also proved: d(L) ≥ n − 1, c(L) = 0 exactly in the tame case, the set of such extensions is infinite exactly when K has equal characteristic p with p ∣ n, and each isomorphism class has n/|Aut_K(L)| members; supporting results include Eisenstein monogenicity, Newton–Hensel lifting over complete DVRs, and Haar volumes of lattices (Serre 1978; Lean proofs AI-generated under Hyeon Seung-Hyeon's direction). (Lean Pool PR #439)

  • Jordan–Schönflies theorem — In ℝ², every homeomorphism between two Jordan curves (images of continuous loops injective on [0,1), with no polygonal restriction) extends to a self-homeomorphism of the plane. The development includes the Jordan curve theorem in the form it uses: the complement of a Jordan curve has a connected bounded inside and a connected unbounded outside, each with the curve as its frontier (130 modules; Lean proofs AI-generated under Álvaro Begué's direction).   • Craig interpolation and Beth definability for propositional dynamic logic — For full PDL with tests and Kleene star, if φ → ψ holds at every world of every Kripke model, there is a formula θ with φ → θ and θ → ψ valid whose atomic propositions and atomic programs all occur in both φ and ψ; local Beth definability follows: a formula that implicitly defines a propositional letter p yields an explicit definition of p in its vocabulary without p. The interpolant comes from uniform cyclic tableaux, with tableau soundness and completeness (consistent ↔ satisfiable for free sequents); the results are existence statements with no extraction algorithm or complexity bound (Borzechowski et al., arXiv:2503.13276; human contributors and Aristotle; reuses the finite game determinacy already pooled in Lean4GlCoalgebras).
